Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1990
ACT VI OF 1990
SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
Art Act to amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 17th July, 1990]
No. PAS/Legis: B-2/90, dated
17-7-1990.--The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th June, 1990 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 9th July, 1990 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972

ACT VI OF 1990
ACT VI OF 1990
SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
Art Act to amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 17th July, 1990]
No. PAS/Legis: B-2/90, dated
17-7-1990.--The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th June, 1990 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 9th July, 1990 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 4 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972.--In. the
Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972, in section 4, for subsection (4),
the following shall be substituted:--
"(4) Chief
Minister of Sindh or any person nominated by him shall be the Chief Game Warden
and ex-officio Chairman of the Board."

Repeal of Sindh Ordinance I of 1990
